text: Bella app, ma il widget solo su abbonamento.
author: Blade Runner
developer_reply: Thanks for the review. I'm an independent developer and I rely on premium features to support ongoing improvements and make a living. I aim to keep the core app and essential features free, with no limits on daily tasks. I also offer a range of pricing options to keep things accessible. If the app doesn't meet your needs, I completely understand.
